data.exact_reserve_text: The claims ratio of Syndicate 6107 has deteriorated to 56% in 2024 (2023: 34%). The claims ratio worsened due to the variability of prior year claims releases year on year. In 2023 there were claims releases across the syndicate's book. In 2024 while the Property Risks experienced prior year reserve releases, the cyber book demonstrated reserve strengthening, arising from adverse development on older year risks.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $24.968m. During 2024 there was a gross prioryear release of $4.367m (favourable development), driven overall by releases in the Property risks offset by adverse development (strengthening) in the Cyber portfolio on older years. The movement is reported in the technical provisions reconciliation (Change in estimates of prior year provisions: gross -4,367 $'000).
raw_causal_phrases: variability of prior year claims releases year on year
claims releases across the syndicate's book
Property Risks experienced prior year reserve releases
the cyber book demonstrated reserve strengthening, arising from adverse development on older year risks
data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) prior-year comparative column. Prior year development (gross) taken from Note 12 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross column). Gross premium mix is derived from the managing agent's divisional summary ('property', 'digital', 'cyber') as no statutory segmental/regulatory class table was provided; percentages used as printed. Claims development triangle is present in Note 12 and used as supporting data. No specific named catastrophe events or specific prior accident years affecting reserves were detailed beyond 'older year risks'.
